A. حرف عطف مبني على الفتح (conjunction particle built on fatha)
B. فعل ماض مبني على الضم (past verb built on damma)

We need correct answer. In Arabic grammar, "إنّ" is a particle of emphasis (حرف توكيد) and also a particle of نصب (it causes the following noun to be in accusative). So D is correct: "حرف توكيد ونصب". So answer D.

FINAL: D
